answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 182642 Country: India Title: Passing wind frequently and breaking wudu. Question: I have bloating in stomach, when I am in stress or anxiety and I pass wind during salah, should I perform wudu again? This is happening on a daily basis. Answer ID: 182642 Posted on: Sep 6, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 76/40/SD=1/1443) Yes! If you are not Ma’zoor (an excused person) as per the Shariah as is clear [from the question] and wind passed during salah then wudhu will break and you will have to make wudhu and offer salah again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
